The '''Alderaanian nectar''' was an aroma. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C2-N2 (Hero of Tython)|C2-N2]] reprogrammed the [[Food synthesizer/Legends|food synthesizer]] of [[Hero of Tython]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], simulating the smell of the nectar among other aromas.<ref name="Ambient">{{TORcite|Ambient Conversation aboard the ''Defender''-class corvette}}</ref>
